raster tile zoom is one ahead of the map zoom for 256 px tiles and rounds half up
across the crossfade the blended map stays dark, pixel for pixel
the fading topo layer is never drawn on tile level 10 or shallower
Street's night style JSON is byte-identical to before
Satellite's night style JSON is byte-identical to its day JSON
raster-opacity evaluates as the style spec defines it, and other expressions are refused
the caption at topo night credits both sources
day style JSON is byte-identical to before for every basemap
